notes: Flags: fits. The light-colored desk chair for the house style (white and beige, where CENTERHALV ikea-10601124 is black and MARKUS ikea-90289172 dark gray), and $80 less than CENTERHALV. Height adjusts 40 1/2"-44 7/8"; seat 17 3/4"-22 7/8"; the armrests (27 1/8" at their lowest) stay above the MICKE's 24 3/4" under-desk height, so the chair parks in front of the desk, not under it (F-35 counts it out). A set sold as one article (the URL's s49424465). Only 2 left in IKEA Long Island, NY on 2026-10-22. 728 reviews; not badged; on the Desk chairs list sorted Most popular. rooms: back-bedroom, from the staging brief.
